_readme: Copy this file to upload.config.json and fill every field. Never commit upload.config.json to git.

google._model_note: If mistral-small-4-119b-2603 is unavailable on your account, set all three to meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct

paths._help: Use absolute paths on Windows (double backslashes) or forward slashes

upload._visibility_note: IMPORTANT: Before first run, go to YouTube Studio → Settings → Upload defaults → set Visibility to Public
